objective: Primary turbine-system validation of a frozen semi-empirical VIV closure against the Fu et al. IEA-10-MW high-fidelity response sweep over multiple blade orientations and wind speeds.

allowed_training_evidence.study: Horcas et al. 2022 IEA-10-MW inflow-angle map
allowed_training_evidence.allowed_role: Angular activation, configuration dependence, and approximate peak-to-peak edgewise response at U=18 m/s; the Figure 4 map is graphical HFM evidence rather than author-provided raw data.
allowed_training_evidence.prohibited_role: No Fu non-18-m/s response value may enter fitting through this source.

allowed_training_evidence.study: Grinderslev et al. 2022 IEA-10-MW forced-motion and FSI response
allowed_training_evidence.allowed_role: Signed aerodynamic-power shape, nonlinear saturation, structural-damping balance, and trigger-dependent multiple-amplitude behavior.
allowed_training_evidence.prohibited_role: It cannot identify the wind-speed dependence of the Fu sweep.

acceptance.configuration_peak_speed_rule: Within each configuration, the predicted and target maximum-amplitude speeds among the four scored speeds may differ by at most one 4 m/s sampling interval.
acceptance.aggregate_rule: Every active-amplitude, inactive-classification, active-frequency, and configuration-peak-speed gate must pass; no averaging may hide a failed operating point.

required_before_predictions: training row identities and source hashes
freeze_rule.no_retuning: No coefficient, input, structural property, trigger, scoring threshold, or analysis choice may be changed after the 16 primary target rows are evaluated while retaining a validation claim.
freeze_rule.failure_policy: A failure is preserved as evidence. Any failed Fu row subsequently used for fitting becomes training data and cannot later be relabeled as validation.

claim_boundary.supports: High-fidelity numerical turbine-system validation of edgewise tip-response amplitude, VIV/non-VIV classification, response frequency, and sampled peak-speed location over the scored matrix.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Experimental validation, H-VAWT validation, spanwise load validation, rainflow/DEL agreement, fatigue life, or certification.
claim_boundary.h_vawt_promotion: The H-VAWT pilot may be submitted only after this primary turbine-system protocol passes for a frozen model.
